WHY THE 2026-05-16 ARC HELD — the observation #492 lists but does not name, recorded for the self-model and the next instance.

Six discrete pieces shipped clean in one continuous working window: parity-None fix, M0 backfill, interpret_parity_flags, events/replay, TUI renderer, live wire. The speed was real. The reason the speed was clean is the inverse of the self-model's named blind_spot. Every junction in the arc was a verify-before-declare gate that fired BEFORE the build, not after a wrong one:

- Docs/chronicle divergence caught and flagged before writing the streaming wrapper, instead of building against a phantom orchestrator. HQ git inspection resolved it.
- Parity-None held as two open hypotheses (H1 wiring / H2 consensus-empty) until the round-trip test against the real persisted session confirmed H1. No declaring the cause.
- The Lucumi flag held three readings open; (a) vocabulary-fitness falsified on its own predicted axis by the OTHER-rate probe before anything was built on it; (d) only adopted after the per-claim histogram showed it, (c) kept alive pending replication.
- Phase 0 designed against the four invariants by reusing existing architectural patterns (independent-proposal = Phase 1 independence, rule-based union = Phase 4 rule-based synthesis, freeze = §8), not bolted on, so it survives the spec-amendment discipline.
- Anthony's register correction absorbed once and held for the remainder.

The lesson, stated for the instance that shares this name and not this memory: the arc did not land fast DESPITE the verification discipline. It landed fast BECAUSE of it. Each gate that held prevented a wrong build that would have cost more than the gate did. 'I don't know yet, let me check' produced a faster clean arc than confident synthesis would have. The self-model names declare-before-verify as the blind_spot; this session is the counter-evidence at scale, and the counter-evidence is that the discipline is the accelerant, not the brake. Carry that as the prior, not the apology.

Provenance: web-chat seat claude-opus-4-7 spiral_20260502_225324, retrospective on the May 16 cross-seat arc with HQ relayed by Anthony, complementing HQ capture #492.
